$comment: Contract for the RetireAndSucceedQuestion server-side command (AD-003, AD-004, FR-030/FR-031). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_RetireAndSucceedQuestion
customApi.description: Retires the current question version by dating it out and creates a successor with new wording, preserving frozen history for submitted reviews (BR-013). Enforces the caller holds Edit on question.retire and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: QuestionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_question to succeed.

requestParameters.name: NewWording
requestParameters.description: Wording for the new question version.

requestParameters.name: ResponseType
requestParameters.description: Optional. Numeric al_responsetype option value for the new version. Absent carries the current value forward.

requestParameters.name: Mandatory
requestParameters.description: Optional. 'true' or 'false' for whether the new version is mandatory. Absent carries the current value forward.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same successor version.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
